newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber mixed, short-covering seen.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber mixed, short-covering seen.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted mixed at noon, with short-covering activities giving life to an otherwise dead market, dealers said.
A sale of SMR20 to Britain was done in early trade while unconfirmed deals of other small parcels were reported, said the dealers.
"We've got a small parcel of SMR20 going to U.K. in July for 264 (cents a kg)," said an official trade source.
At noon, July RSS 1 buyer was officially quoted at 284.50 cents ($1.13) a kg, up half cent from Thursday's close. July SMR 20 buyer was half cent down at 264.
A check with trading houses at noon showed the SMR 20 was offered at 260 cents, SMR CV at 331, SMR L at 308, SMR 10 at 262 and drum latex at 226.
A Malaysian-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU and $1,700 per two-TEU containers.
